note: Holds industry context, judgment dimensions, follow-up questions, evidence interpretation and links to jobs. Industries do not change scores: `axis_emphasis` marks the axes an industry looks at more closely and does not enter axis-level calculation. `scene` is a short introduction shown before Core screening and produces no score
reading_rule: An industry pack is not a quiz on industry knowledge. What it looks at is whether the person can recognize their existing computer science and software experience in that industry's problems and connect the two. So each item has a `gloss` restating the decision in general computer science and software terms, and the test screen shows that line with the item. Not knowing industry jargon is never recorded as a poor fit

exploration.note: All eight industries can be explored in the results. At the start of the test the person picks up to two industries of interest, reads the scenes for those industries before Core screening, and is asked in depth about one of them in PRO. Industries not picked are compared lightly using Core results. Do not change this into a structure where industry packs unlock only with a subscription
